verdict.rationale: Brex documents dedicated AI features covering the story directly: an audit agent that monitors expenses and categorizes violations by risk (fraud/duplicate-style detection), a review agent that auto-approves/escalates, and AI assistants that write memos, fetch receipts, and file reimbursements automatically, plus receipt-matching in the expenses API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI agents' real-world accuracy (e.g., explicit duplicate/fraud catch examples) and no third-party review confirming performance.
